mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS application_id, s.id AS student_id, s.name AS student_name, CONCAT(j.company_name, ' ', j.title) AS job_title, a.status, a.submitted_at, a.reviewed_at, a.delivered_at, j.deadline_on, j.until_filled FROM application a JOIN student s ON s.id = a.student_id JOIN job_posting j ON j.id = a.job_posting_id WHERE a.status IN #{st} ORDER BY a.submitted_at ASC, a.id ASC
